ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Microsoft OneNote Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious child processes of the Microsoft OneNote application. This may indicate an attempt to execute malicious embedded objects from a .one file.

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\onenote\\\.exe$") AND (((process_original_file_name = "bitsadmin\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "CertOC\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "CertUtil\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe" OR process_original_file_name = "CMSTP\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "cscript\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "curl\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "HH\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "IEExec\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "InstallUtil\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "javaw\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "Microsoft\.Workflow\.Compiler\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "msdt\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "MSHTA\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "msiexec\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "Msxsl\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "odbcconf\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "pcalua\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "RegAsm\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "RegSvcs\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "REGSVR32\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "schtasks\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "ScriptRunner\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "wmic\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "WorkFolders\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "wscript\.exe") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\AppVLP\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certoc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmstp\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\control\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\curl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\forfiles\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\hh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ieexec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\installutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\javaw\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mftrace\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Microsoft\\\.Workflow\\\.Compiler\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msbuild\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msdt\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msidb\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msxsl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\odbcconf\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pcalua\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regasm\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvcs\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\scrcons\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\scriptrunner\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\verclsid\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\workfolders\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.hta.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.vb.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.wsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.js.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ps.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.scr.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pif.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cmd.*"))) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks\\\\.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\Teams\\\\current\\\\Teams\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX("\\-Embedding$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\OneDrive\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\FileCoAuth\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX("\\-Embedding$")))
